capabilities: Generate LaTeX from clipboard images via a paste command
Convert vault images to LaTeX from the file context menu
Run inference through the HuggingFace API with an API key
Run the model locally through an installed Python package
Monitor local server and model download status in the status bar
extras: The README warns the HuggingFace Inference API is currently broken for image-to-text models, so only local mode works; the free API has a cold-start provisioning delay, and the author floats a possible paid subscription service. Local mode downloads a ~1.4 GB model and GPU support requires installing PyTorch with CUDA.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to transcribe an equation from an image or screenshot into editable LaTeX, so users must retype formulas by hand.

relations.evidence: By default, this plugin uses the HuggingFace inference API.
Massive thanks to NormXU for training and releasing the model.

summary: OCR plugin that converts images and clipboard screenshots of equations into LaTeX code in your notes, via HuggingFace API or a local model.
